description: Fungal disease (Venturia inaequalis) causing olive-green to brown scabby lesions on leaves and fruit.
treatment_text: Apply a fungicide labeled for apple scab (e.g. captan or a triazole) starting at green-tip stage and repeat per label interval through wet spring weather. Remove and destroy fallen leaves in autumn to cut inoculum.
prevention_text: Plant scab-resistant cultivars where possible. Prune for good air circulation and avoid overhead irrigation that keeps foliage wet.

description: Fungal disease (Botryosphaeria obtusa) causing purple-bordered leaf spots and fruit rot.
treatment_text: Prune out cankered or dead wood and remove mummified fruit. Apply a labeled fungicide during the growing season, especially after storm damage.
prevention_text: Sanitize pruning tools between cuts, remove nearby dead wood/debris, and maintain tree vigor with balanced fertilization.

description: Fungal disease requiring a nearby juniper/cedar host, causing bright orange leaf spots.
treatment_text: Apply a protectant fungicide from pink bud through several weeks after petal fall in years with nearby cedar hosts.
prevention_text: Remove nearby juniper/cedar trees if feasible, or plant rust-resistant apple cultivars.

description: No visible disease symptoms detected.
treatment_text: No treatment necessary.
prevention_text: Continue routine monitoring, balanced fertilization, and good orchard sanitation.

description: Fungal disease (Guignardia bidwellii) causing tan leaf spots with dark borders and shriveled fruit.
treatment_text: Apply fungicide starting at 2-3 inch shoot growth and continue through fruit set per label; remove mummified berries.
prevention_text: Prune for canopy airflow, remove infected plant debris, and avoid working in wet vineyards.

description: Complex fungal trunk disease causing tiger-stripe leaf discoloration and berry spotting.
treatment_text: No curative fungicide exists; remove and destroy severely affected vines/wood, protect pruning wounds with a wound sealant.
prevention_text: Prune during dry weather, avoid large pruning wounds, and maintain vine vigor to slow disease progression.

description: Fungal disease causing angular brown leaf spots that can lead to defoliation.
treatment_text: Apply a labeled fungicide at first symptom appearance and repeat through the growing season in humid conditions.
prevention_text: Improve canopy airflow via leaf pulling/pruning and avoid excess nitrogen that promotes dense foliage.

description: No visible disease symptoms detected.
treatment_text: No treatment necessary.
prevention_text: Continue routine canopy management and vineyard sanitation.

description: Fungal disease (Cercospora zeae-maydis) causing rectangular gray-tan lesions between leaf veins.
treatment_text: Apply a foliar fungicide at early symptom onset in susceptible hybrids, particularly under humid conditions.
prevention_text: Rotate away from corn, till under infected residue, and plant resistant hybrids.

description: Fungal disease (Puccinia sorghi) producing small, cinnamon-brown pustules on both leaf surfaces.
treatment_text: Apply a labeled fungicide if rust develops before tasseling on susceptible hybrids.
prevention_text: Plant rust-resistant hybrids; rust is usually not yield-limiting on resistant varieties.

description: Fungal disease causing long, elliptical gray-green to tan lesions on leaves.
treatment_text: Apply a foliar fungicide at first sign of lesions, especially between tasseling and silking.
prevention_text: Rotate crops, till residue, and select resistant hybrids where blight pressure is historically high.

description: No visible disease symptoms detected.
treatment_text: No treatment necessary.
prevention_text: Continue routine scouting and residue/rotation management.

description: Bacterial disease causing small, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit.
treatment_text: Apply a copper-based bactericide at first sign of disease; avoid overhead watering to limit spread.
prevention_text: Use certified disease-free seed/transplants, rotate crops, and avoid working in wet plants.

description: Fungal disease (Alternaria solani) causing target-like concentric-ring leaf spots, usually on older leaves first.
treatment_text: Apply a labeled fungicide (e.g. chlorothalonil or a strobilurin) on a regular schedule once symptoms appear; remove affected lower leaves.
prevention_text: Mulch to reduce soil splash, stake/prune for airflow, and rotate with non-solanaceous crops.

description: Oomycete disease (Phytophthora infestans) causing rapidly spreading water-soaked lesions; can destroy a crop in days under cool, wet conditions.
treatment_text: Apply a labeled fungicide immediately at first symptoms and remove/destroy severely infected plants to slow spread; this disease can be highly destructive if untreated.
prevention_text: Plant resistant varieties, avoid overhead irrigation, ensure good airflow, and monitor local blight forecasts during cool wet weather.

description: No visible disease symptoms detected.
treatment_text: No treatment necessary.
prevention_text: Continue routine scouting, balanced watering, and crop rotation.

description: Fungal disease (Diplocarpon earlianum) causing small purple spots that merge into scorched-looking patches.
treatment_text: Remove and destroy infected leaves after harvest and apply a labeled fungicide during wet spring conditions.
prevention_text: Renovate beds annually, avoid overhead irrigation, and space plants for airflow.

description: No visible disease symptoms detected.
treatment_text: No treatment necessary.
prevention_text: Continue routine bed renovation and irrigation management.

description: Bacterial disease causing small dark leaf spots (often with a 'shot-hole' appearance) and pitted fruit lesions.
treatment_text: Apply a labeled copper or antibiotic bactericide during the dormant/early season per local guidance; avoid working in wet orchards.
prevention_text: Plant resistant varieties, maintain tree vigor, and avoid excess nitrogen that produces susceptible new growth.

description: No visible disease symptoms detected.
treatment_text: No treatment necessary.
prevention_text: Continue routine orchard monitoring and balanced fertilization.
